eu_examples.codex.storm.intro: A sign torn from the sky itself.
eu_examples.codex.storm.body: Chanted with Soul on either side, the Storm sign calls lightning down on whatever the chanter looks at, but only while the heavens are already restless.
eu_examples.codex.storm.chant: Soul, Storm, Soul: the Call of the Storm.
eu_examples.codex.myrkul.intro: He who sits upon the bones of all things.
eu_examples.codex.myrkul.body: Myrkul rises from a rift of soul-fire, a mound of the dead piling beneath him. Those who earn his regard may call on his boon; those who fail him feed the pile.
eu_examples.codex.sign.storm.title: Storm Sign
eu_examples.codex.myrkul.avatar: Myrkul, Lord of Bones, does not walk among the living. He tears the ground open into a rift of soul-fire and hauls himself out of it, the dead piling into a throne beneath him. Those who would call him should stand well back.
eu_examples.codex.pantheon.light: The Light comes through a gate of radiant stone. Her doors part, the glow spills out, and she glides through to bless or to judge those who called.
eu_examples.codex.pantheon.dark: The Dark comes through a gate of night. Its leaves open on a turning void, and she steps out of it with her eye still closed, until she chooses to look upon you.
eu_examples.codex.sign.storm: The Storm sign is the mark of the restless sky. Chanted between two Soul signs it calls lightning down on whatever the chanter watches, but the heavens answer only when they are already stirring.
eu_examples.discovery.sea_memory: The sea remembers the drowned, and now so do you.
eu_examples.discovery.deep_dark: In the silence, a sign of storms takes shape in your mind.
eu_examples.discovery.forgotten: The Forgotten's last breath carries Myrkul's rites to you.
eu_examples.discovery.thrall: The dead obey you. You have learned what that means.
